discord_bot_token: <Discord bot token, keep this file chmod 600>
owner_id: <your Discord user ID; only your messages are forwarded>
grok_channel: <Discord channel ID for Grok Bot, or empty to turn it off>
instinct_channel: <Discord channel ID for Instinct (iMessage), or empty>
pickle_channel: <Discord channel ID for Pickle, or empty>
dots_channel: <Discord channel ID for the ChatGPT dots room, or empty>
grok_bot_id: <Grok Bot ID, the last part of the grok.com bot chat URL>
mail_account: <zele account name for the Gmail that gets Grok scheduled-task mail, or empty>
grok_mail_query: from:<sender address of Grok scheduled-task mail> newer_than:2d
instinct_handle: <phone number or Apple ID that Instinct texts you from>
dots_url: <URL of the dots room page on chatgpt.com>
dots_member: <account_user_id of the dots member in that room>
